provenance.asset_description: Two illustrations over-layed over a warm red toned background. In the foreground, Kreighton Shane, the elven Master of Scrolls of the Pathfinder Society, reads from a large tome covered in eyes. In the background, Skyreach, the central fortress of the Pathfinder Society’s Grand Lodge in Absalom and the tree-lined walkway leading up to it
